decision_rule: Only revise the driver-like minimal contract if deployable ego-speed or visual-flow cues improve probes under the same frozen recipe without weakening the non-oracle input boundary.
failure_criteria: profile adds path error, heading error, TTC, required clearance, feasibility labels, mu, slip ratio, or tire-force diagnostics
speed-cue gains are single-seed or fail learned-history repeat
hypothesis: M143/M144 P1 may be too strict because it removes ego speed cues that a real driver has through speedometer and visual flow; adding deployable speed cues may recover P0-level observability without oracle leakage.
success_criteria: profile definitions distinguish deployable ego-speed cues from planner/oracle fields
supervised and learned-history probes use the same seeds and recipes as M143/M144 where possible
at least three seeds are run
artifacts record whether speed-cue profiles close the P1 vs P0 gap
